meta: Read your rental contract with AI before signing: many people lose their deposit because of one small line.

muc.title: Losing a deposit over one line
muc.text: Many people lose their deposit over a single line in the lease. AI helps you check before you sign.

muc.title: Remove names and ID numbers
muc.text: Photograph the contract and cover both sides' names, ID numbers and bank account numbers before pasting into AI.

muc.title: Deposit, penalties, repairs
muc.text: Ask AI to summarize three things: deposit return terms, penalties for moving out early, and who pays for repairs.

muc.title: Make vague parts clear
muc.text: For vague parts, ask AI to draft questions for the landlord so they're written into the contract. For big disputes, ask a lawyer.

muc.title: A photo checklist
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a checklist of photos to take on move-in day, as evidence when you get your deposit back.
